Sam — thanks for the context, that helps. Looping in Soojin (security lead) and Karthik (solutions) so we can coordinate an approach that minimizes rework.

Options that would work from our side:
A) Split approach (recommended):
  - Product walkthrough (45 mins): July 7 or July 8 — focused on product fit, UX, and integration points.
  - Security + procurement deep-dive (60–90 mins): the following week with Soojin + procurement SME present. We can bring a short tech runbook and compliance artifacts.

B) Full-runthrough with CTO: shift complete session to July 12–15 window. Longer single meeting (~90 mins) so we can cover technical, security, and commercial topics.

Please tell us which you prefer and share names/emails of the additional attendees so we can include them (and send a short prep pack). Im attaching the security checklist so your security team can scan ahead (security-onboarding-checklist.xlsx).

Links: HubSpot record (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/BC-2027-0452) and demo folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-demo-materials

1) Product walkthrough (45 mins): Tuesday, July 13 — 10:00 AM PT
  - Attendees (requested): Sam Jacobs, engineering leads, product managers
2) Security & procurement workshop (75 mins): Thursday, July 15 — 9:30 AM PT
  - Attendees (requested): Lydia Chen (Head of Security), procurement lead, Soojin, Karthik, Mina
If procurement needs more time we can extend the security session by 30 minutes. Please confirm: which names should be on the invites and which time option do you prefer? If July 13/15 are hard we can move the product walkthrough to July 12 and security to July 14 — flexibility available.

Calendar invite (tentative): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-demo-proposed
